scope: Additive TH18 regular Giant L1-L14 direct-parent and Defense-priority fallback baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; the corroborating current secondary page does not publish a client build.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: The official TH18 update announces that some troops receive new levels but names neither Giant nor any Giant statistic, targeting, route or timing value.

sources.title: Giant — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports current L1-L14 HP/DPS, 5 housing, ground targeting, 2-second cadence, one-tile range, speed 12, Defense preference and nearest-target fallback after every Defense is destroyed. It does not publish route topology, collision, hitbox, target-loss, wind-up, tie or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Giant
sources.limitations: Corroborates L1-L14 values, 12 movement, 2-second cadence, one-tile range, ground-only attack and Defense priority with nearest-building fallback. It says that mobile enemy behavior after a prior target is destroyed can differ, but does not supply a deterministic measurement or client build.

support.note: The L1-L14 ground parent, Defense-priority and documented no-Defense nearest-target fallback use shared Core targeting; Headless, Viewer and RL consume that same immutable GameData route.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent despite a frozen secondary observation of its L1-L14 table and Defense-priority fallback.
changed_values.replacement: The existing shared Core Defense-priority and fallback route is explicitly validated for the current L1-L14 parent through focused Core, snapshot/replay and Headless CLI coverage.
changed_values.justification: A build-pinned current table and an independent current secondary page agree on values and target preference. No route topology, collision, target-loss or timing rule is added.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Giant route topology, wall-route selection, collision, target hitbox, attack wind-up, target loss, same-tick retarget ordering, target ties or visual animation timing.

The secondary page describes nearest-target fallback but does not define its geometric metric or candidate ordering; Core's existing distance then entity-ID tie break remains a deterministic simulator rule, not asserted as client fidelity.
The current exact values and targeting contract are secondary; the consulted official TH18 note does not publish Giant-specific quantitative data.
conclusion: Giant L1-L14 is executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a ground Defense-priority parent with the documented no-Defense fallback. Route, collision, tie, timing and visual fidelity remain partial.
